name: SERGIO target interaction parameters
description: Comma-separated SERGIO target interaction file consumed by sergio.build_graph(input_file_taregts). Each row defines all regulators and Hill-function parameters for one non-master target gene.
validation_notes: Rows have variable width: target_id, regulator_count, regulator_id_1..regulator_id_n, K_1..K_n, hill_coeff_1..hill_coeff_n.
Gene identifiers must be zero-based numeric SERGIO IDs and must match the master-regulator file and number_genes parameter.
K values are signed maximum interaction strengths; positive values represent activation and negative values represent repression.
Master regulators must not be included as target rows in this file.
When shared_coop_state is greater than zero, SERGIO ignores per-row hill_coeff values but the file may still include them.
